shadows.name: train-halo
shadows.purpose: Separates the train from the track.

shadows.name: outline-button-ring
shadows.purpose: Stop and Monitor again button ring.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Start monitoring, Open CAESAR, Solve captcha.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font: 700 13px 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: #4e2a84; color: #fff; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3d206a; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6b3fc0; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Stop monitoring and Monitor again; neutral, never red.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { font: 700 13px 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: #17151f; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px #5c5a6c; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #eeeef3; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6b3fc0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Course Roundel
components.css: .ds-roundel { font: 700 12px/1 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .02em; color: #fff; background: #4e2a84; border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px 12px; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Sunken sign-slot input with a muted bottom rule.
components.css: .ds-label { display: grid; gap: 3px; font: 600 11px 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #5c5a6c; } .ds-input { font: 500 13px 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #17151f; background: #eeeef3; border: 1px solid transparent; border-bottom-color: #5c5a6c; border-radius: 4px 4px 0 0; padding: 0 8px; height: 30px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #5c5a6c; font-weight: 400; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-bottom: 2px solid #6b3fc0; background: #f8f8fa; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #d9d8e2; }

components.name: Header Band
components.description: Purple band with wordmark and verification status.
components.css: .ds-band { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px 0 16px; background: #4e2a84; color: #fff; font: 12px 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-band b { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Course | Activity tabs with a 3px purple underline.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 16px; border-bottom: 2px solid #d9d8e2; } .ds-tabs button { font: 700 13px 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #5c5a6c; background: none; border: 0; border-bottom: 3px solid transparent; margin-bottom: -2px; padding: 4px 0 7px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tabs button:hover { color: #17151f; } .ds-tabs button.on { color: #17151f; border-color: #4e2a84; } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6b3fc0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Route Strip
components.description: Signature: track with end stations and a train showing time since last check.
components.css: .ds-route { position: relative; height: 18px; margin: 12px 6px 0; width: 240px; } .ds-track { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 7px; height: 4px; background: #d9d8e2; border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-done { width: 40%; height: 100%; background: #4e2a84; } .ds-stn { position: absolute; top: 3px; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; background: #f8f8fa; border: 3px solid #4e2a84; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-train { position: absolute; left: 40%; top: 4px; width: 10px; height: 10px; margin-left: -5px; border-radius: 50%; background: #4e2a84; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #f8f8fa; }

components.name: Activity Rail
components.description: Activity log as a line of stops.
components.css: .ds-stops { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0 0 0 14px; position: relative; font: 12px 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #17151f; } .ds-stops::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 4px; top: 12px; bottom: 12px; width: 3px; background: #4e2a84; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-stops li { position: relative; display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 3px 0; } .ds-stops li::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -14px; top: 8px; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #f8f8fa; border: 2px solid #4e2a84; box-sizing: content-box; margin-left: -1px; } .ds-stops time { font: 500 11px/1.7 ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; color: #5c5a6c; }

narrative.overview:
A 340x520 tray popover dressed as transit wayfinding: a saturated Northwestern-purple band across the top, signage-white (light) or night-platform near-black (dark) ground, a white-on-purple roundel naming the course, and a route strip whose stations carry state. The scene is a glance at a platform sign: which class, is the line running, what is the count, when is the next check. It is recognizable with the text removed: band, roundel, line with stations.

Density is compact and calm. Humanist transit sans with tabular numerals does all the work; colour is spent on one line colour (purple) and three status colours. Light and dark follow the OS and are two times of day on the same platform, not two themes.
keyCharacteristics: Purple band header is the only fully saturated surface; the rest is near-neutral tinted toward violet.
One line colour (purple) for action, selection, the route and the activity rail.
Status colours (ok, warn, bad) appear only as the status dot, the alert state, and error text.
Flat: no elevation shadows, depth by tonal sunken fields and 2px rules.
Tabular numerals for every count and time.

rules.name: The One Line Rule
rules.body: Purple is the only brand colour; it marks what is active or actionable. Status colours never decorate and never appear as button fills.

rules.name: The Day/Night Pair Rule
rules.body: Every semantic colour has a light and a dark value defined together in app.css; new colours are added as a pair and contrast-checked on both grounds.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any number that changes (count, countdown, clock) uses tabular numerals so the layout does not shift between polls.

dos: Do keep the purple band, roundel and route strip as the three constants of any new screen.
Do use purple (accent) only for what is active or actionable; use status colours only for status.
Do define any new colour as a light/night pair and set it as a CSS custom property in app.css.
Do use tabular numerals for all changing numbers and 24h en-GB clocks.
Do keep placeholders, disabled fields and muted text at the muted token values so they stay legible.
donts: Don't make the Stop button red or fill it with a status colour.
Don't add elevation shadows, gradients or pastel status cards; depth is tonal.
Don't introduce a second brand hue or a neutral-gray accent.
Don't hard-code colour hex values in components when a token exists.
